title: albizia bubalina
intro: Albizia bubalina, commonly known as Siris or Black Siris, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Albizia bubalina include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of this plant work synergistically to provide relief from pain and inflammation, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
